phrases.text: Across Hotel, to holding point Runway 07 Right, hold short Runway 07 Left, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the continued progressive taxi instructions including the final hold-short.

phrases.text: Affirm
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: 'Yes' — the standard affirmative; never say 'yeah', 'yep', or 'roger that'.

phrases.text: Behind landing Boeing 777, line up Runway 07 Right behind, traffic in sight, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The mandatory readback restates the condition first and repeats it at the end, confirming the traffic is in sight.

phrases.text: Cancel level restriction.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The instruction deleting published SID altitude ceilings so the aircraft may climb unrestricted.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, airborne zero zero five two, contact Hong Kong Departure on one two three decimal eight.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Tower transfers Cathay 251 to Departure, announcing the airborne time and the new frequency 123.8.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, behind departing Boeing 777, wind 080 degrees, 14 knots, Runway 07 Right, cleared for takeoff.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: A takeoff clearance issued behind the departing Boeing 777, with current wind, authorizing Cathay 251 to begin the takeoff roll.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, behind landing Airbus 320 on two-mile final, line up Runway 07 Right behind.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: A conditional line-up clearance sequencing Cathay 251 behind the landing Airbus 320 on two-mile final.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, BEHIND landing Boeing 777, line up Runway 07 Right BEHIND.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The canonical 4-part ICAO conditional clearance format: callsign, condition, traffic identification, instruction, condition repeated.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, cancel level restriction, climb to Flight Level one six zero, expedite through Flight Level one zero zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Departure cancels the SID level restrictions and orders a climb to FL160, expedited through FL100.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, cancel level restriction, climb to Flight Level one six zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The pure taught form cancelling published step-climb caps for an unrestricted climb to FL160.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, cancel takeoff clearance, hold position.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The command cancelling a takeoff clearance before the roll starts; the aircraft must remain in position.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, climb via SID to Flight Level zero nine zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The pure taught form of the climb-via-SID clearance: follow the published lateral route and all altitude/speed constraints up to FL090.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, correction, QNH 1013.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The controller corrects their own error: the correct altimeter setting is QNH 1013, not 1014.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, cross Runway 07 Left at Hotel. Report vacated.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Clearance to cross Runway 07L only at taxiway Hotel, with a requirement to report once the runway is vacated.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, de-icing completed. Type four fluid applied, start of holdover time zero zero four five, post de-icing inspection complete.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The de-icing crew reports treatment complete: Type IV fluid applied, holdover time starting at 00:45, post-treatment inspection done.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, expedite climb through Flight Level one four zero, crossing traffic opposite direction.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Departure orders an expedited climb through FL140 because of crossing traffic in the opposite direction.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, expedite climb through Flight Level one zero zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The pure taught command to increase vertical speed through FL100.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, hold short of Runway 07 Left on Hotel.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC instructs the aircraft to stop before the Runway 07L holding point while on taxiway Hotel.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, hold short of Runway 07 Left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Mandatory instruction to stop before the Runway 07L holding point; the pilot must read back the runway designator and 'hold short' verbatim.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, holdover time expired, unable departure, request return to de-icing pad for re-treatment.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The taught form for reporting expired holdover time and requesting re-treatment.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Delivery, cleared to Tokyo Haneda, OCEAN 2A departure, climb via SID to Flight Level 090, squawk 4321.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC grants the IFR clearance: destination Tokyo Haneda via the OCEAN 2A departure, climb via the SID to Flight Level 090, transponder squawk 4321.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Departure, radar contact.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The canonical short form of the controller's radar identification after Mode C verification.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Departure, radar contact. Climb via SID to Flight Level zero nine zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Departure establishes radar contact and clears Cathay 251 to climb via the SID to FL090, complying with all published lateral, altitude, and speed constraints.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Departure, radar contact. Passing BEKOL, climb to Flight Level one six zero, cancel level restriction.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Departure establishes radar contact, assigns a climb to FL160, and cancels the published SID level restrictions.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Ground, push and start approved, facing west, QNH 1012.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Pushback and start approved, nose to finish facing west, QNH 1012.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Ground, standby. Traffic passing behind.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Wait at the gate — do not push back because another aircraft is taxiing across the pushback path behind.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Ground, taxi to de-icing pad North via taxiway Alpha, hold short of pad entrance.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC clears Cathay 251 to taxi to the de-icing pad via Alpha and hold short of the pad entrance.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Ground, taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via taxiway Alpha and Hotel. Give way to Boeing 777 crossing left to right on Bravo.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Taxi clearance to the Runway 07R holding point via taxiways Alpha and Hotel, with an instruction to yield to a crossing Boeing 777 on Bravo.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Tower, behind landing Boeing 777, line up Runway 07 Right behind.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: A conditional line-up clearance: Cathay 251 may only enter the runway and line up behind the landing Boeing 777.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Tower, cross Runway 07 Left at Hotel, expedite crossing, traffic on five-mile final. Report vacated.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Tower clears the aircraft to cross Runway 07L at Hotel, to expedite because of traffic on five-mile final, and to report vacated.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Hong Kong Tower, Runway 07 Right, line up and wait.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC authorizes Cathay 251 to taxi into position on the runway and align with the centerline; throttles remain at idle — this is not permission to roll.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, negative radar contact. Scope indicates four thousand two hundred feet; you reported passing two thousand five hundred feet. Check altimeter setting and confirm level.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Departure reports no radar contact: the scope shows 4,200 ft versus the reported 2,500 ft, and asks the crew to check the altimeter setting.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, NEGATIVE ROGER! Read back HOLD SHORT Runway 07 Left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The controller rejects the 'Roger' and demands a verbatim readback of the mandatory hold-short instruction.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, NEGATIVE! Confirm TYPE FOUR fluid applied.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The mandatory correction after the pilot mistakenly read back 'Type one fluid' instead of 'Type four fluid'.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, NEGATIVE! HOLD POSITION, line up and wait ONLY.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The mandatory ATC correction after a hearback error where the pilot read back 'cleared for takeoff' instead of 'line up and wait'.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, NEGATIVE! HOLD SHORT of Runway 07 Left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The controller urgently rejects the faulty readback and re-issues the mandatory hold-short instruction.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, negative! Level restriction cancelled, climb unrestricted Flight Level one six zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The mandatory ATC correction after the pilot read back the cancelled SID restriction at BEKOL.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, NEGATIVE! STOP CLIMB IMMEDIATELY at Flight Level one two zero!
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The mandatory ATC correction after the pilot read back 'climbing to FL120' instead of 'stopping climb at FL120'.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, NEGATIVE. HOLD SHORT of Runway 07 Left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC immediately corrects the error: 'NEGATIVE' (that was wrong) -- hold short of Runway 07 Left.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, NEGATIVE. Push and start approved, facing EAST.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The controller rejects the faulty readback and re-issues the clearance with the correct facing direction east.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, NEGATIVE. Push and start approved, facing NORTH.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The controller rejects the faulty readback and re-issues the clearance with the correct facing direction north.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, NEGATIVE. QNH one zero one four.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The controller rejects the faulty readback and re-issues the correct QNH 1014.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, proceed across Hotel, continue to holding point Runway 07 Right, hold short Runway 07 Left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Continued progressive guidance: cross Hotel, continue to the Runway 07R holding point, and hold short of Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, progressive taxi approved. Follow taxiway Alpha, turn left onto taxiway Juliet, hold short of taxiway Hotel.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC approves progressive taxi and issues the first turn-by-turn instructions.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, push and start approved, facing east, QNH 1014.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Pushback clearance issued with the nose finishing pointing east and QNH 1014.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, push and start approved, facing north, QNH 1012.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Pushback clearance issued with the nose finishing pointing north and QNH 1012.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, push and start approved, facing west, QNH 1014.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Cleared to push back with the nose finishing pointing west and to start engines; the local altimeter setting is QNH 1014.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, radar contact, Mode C verified two thousand five hundred feet. Climb to Flight Level zero nine zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Departure re-establishes radar contact with Mode C verified at 2,500 ft and clears the climb to FL090.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, roger, contact Hong Kong Ground on one two one decimal six.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Frequency change instruction: contact Hong Kong Ground on 121.6 MHz.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, roger, hold short Runway 07 Right.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The controller instructs Cathay 251 to remain holding short of the runway.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, roger, push and start approved, facing west, QNH 1013.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Receipt acknowledged; pushback clearance issued with nose facing west and altimeter setting QNH 1013.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, roger, turn left immediately heading zero six zero for traffic avoidance.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC acknowledges and issues a left turn to heading 060 for traffic avoidance.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, roger, turn right on taxiway Hotel, contact Ground on one two one decimal six for return to de-icing pad.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC acknowledges and routes the aircraft back via Hotel with the ground frequency for return to the pad.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, roger.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: A fatal mistake — the pilot answered with 'Roger' instead of reading back the mandatory hold-short instruction, giving the controller no verification.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Runway 07 Left vacated.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot reports the runway is vacated — transmitted only when the entire aircraft has cleared past the holding line.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Runway 07 Right, line up and wait.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The canonical short form of the line-up authorization: enter the runway, align with the centerline, keep throttles at idle — no permission to roll.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, slot time 0345. Clearance amendment: cancel OCEAN 2A, new departure BEKOL 3A, climb via SID to Flight Level 080. Squawk 7142.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC issues a departure slot time (CTOT 0345) and amends the clearance: OCEAN 2A cancelled, new departure BEKOL 3A, climb to Flight Level 080, new squawk 7142.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, special information Echo current: wind zero six zero degrees, two two knots gusts three five, moderate windshear reported on two-mile final Runway zero seven Left, QNH one zero one one. Acknowledge Echo.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Urgent Special ATIS (SPECI) update: new wind 060° at 22 gusting 35 knots, moderate windshear on the two-mile final for Runway 07L, QNH 1011; pilot must acknowledge the new information letter Echo.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Stand W42, request push and start, Information Echo.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot requests gate departure permission — pushback and engine start — confirming receipt of ATIS Information Echo.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, Stand Whiskey 42.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Repeating the stand number after a blocked transmission.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, STOP CLIMB at Flight Level one two zero!
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The pure taught emergency command to arrest the climb immediately at FL120.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, STOP IMMEDIATELY!
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The emergency abort command used after the takeoff roll has started; the crew must stop the aircraft immediately.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, STOP IMMEDIATELY! Cancel crossing clearance, HOLD SHORT of Runway 07 Left, go-around in progress!
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Emergency instruction to stop immediately and cancel the crossing clearance because a go-around is in progress on Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, STOP IMMEDIATELY! Cancel takeoff clearance, vehicle on the runway!
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The tactical drill's emergency abort: the takeoff clearance is cancelled because an inspection vehicle is on the runway.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, taxi to de-icing pad North via taxiway Alpha, hold short of pad entrance.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The canonical ATC clearance to taxi to the de-icing pad, holding short of the pad entrance.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via Alpha and Hotel, hold short of Runway 07 Left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Taxi clearance with a mandatory hold-short instruction before Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via Alpha, hold short of Runway 07 Left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC instructs the aircraft to taxi to the Runway 07 Right holding point via taxiway Alpha and hold short of Runway 07 Left.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via taxiway Alpha, hold short Runway 07 Left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Taxi clearance to the Runway 07R holding point via taxiway Alpha, with an instruction to hold short of Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, taxi to holding point Runway zero seven Right via taxiway Alpha and Hotel.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC clears Cathay 251 to the runway holding point via Alpha and Hotel.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, taxi via Hotel, hold short of Runway 07 Left.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Taxi instruction via Hotel with a mandatory hold-short before Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, traffic conflict overhead, stop climb at Flight Level one two zero!
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The emergency command to stop the climb at FL120 because of conflicting traffic overhead.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, unable to expedite, maximum vertical speed 800 feet per minute.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The mandatory pilot response when the aircraft cannot climb faster; aerodynamic safety is never sacrificed for an expedite request.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, updated QNH one zero one four.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The controller issues an updated altimeter setting of QNH 1014.

phrases.text: Cathay 251, wind 080 degrees, 14 knots, Runway 07 Right, cleared for takeoff.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The takeoff clearance with wind information, authorizing Cathay 251 to begin the high-speed departure roll.

phrases.text: Cleared to Tokyo Haneda, OCEAN 2A departure, climb via SID Flight Level 090, squawk 4321, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the clearance verbatim (callsign last), confirming every element was understood.

phrases.text: Climb to Flight Level one six zero, cancel level restriction, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's readback of the climb to FL160 with the restriction cancellation.

phrases.text: Climb to Flight Level one six zero, cancel level restriction, expediting through Flight Level one zero zero, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's readback confirming the unrestricted climb to FL160 and expediting through FL100.

phrases.text: Climb to Flight Level zero nine zero, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's readback of the climb to FL090.

phrases.text: Climb via SID to Flight Level zero nine zero, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's readback of the climb-via-SID clearance.

phrases.text: Contact
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: 'Establish communications with...' — tune the frequency and transmit a full standard initial call.

phrases.text: Correction
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: 'An error was made in this transmission. Correct version is...' — used immediately upon noticing your own speaking error.

phrases.text: Correction, Runway zero seven Left, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The correct way to fix a self-made error — having misstated Runway 07R instead of 07L, the pilot issues a CORRECTION.

phrases.text: Cross Runway 07 Left at Hotel, expediting, report vacated, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the crossing clearance with the expedite and report-vacated requirements.

phrases.text: Expedite crossing Runway 07 Left, traffic on 5-mile final.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Cross the runway without delay and do not stop on the runway centerline because landing traffic is on a five-mile final.

phrases.text: Expediting through Flight Level one zero zero, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's readback confirming the expedited climb through FL100.

phrases.text: Facing west
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The pushback 'facing' direction always refers to where the NOSE of the aircraft will point when pushback is completed.

phrases.text: Follow Alpha, left on Juliet, hold short of Hotel, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the first progressive taxi instructions.

phrases.text: Give way to Boeing 777 crossing left to right on Bravo
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Yield right-of-way to intersecting taxi traffic — hold short of the intersection until the crossing Boeing 777 passes clear.

phrases.text: Ground from flight deck, brakes released, cleared to push.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The intercom call to the ground tug driver confirming the parking brake is off and the tug may start pushing the aircraft back.

phrases.text: Hold short of Runway 07 Left
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Mandatory instruction to stop before the runway holding point markings (two solid and two dashed yellow lines); must be read back verbatim.

phrases.text: Hold short Runway 07 Left on Hotel, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Verbatim readback of the mandatory hold-short instruction.

phrases.text: Holding position, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The correct response to a 'hold position' instruction — read back the hold, never just say 'Roger'.

phrases.text: Holding short Runway 07 Right, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Standard readback of the hold-short instruction.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Delivery, Cathay 251, Stand Whiskey 42, Information Bravo, request clearance to Tokyo Haneda.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot requests an IFR departure clearance to Tokyo Haneda, reporting position (Stand Whiskey 42) and that the crew has the latest ATIS (Information Bravo).

phrases.text: Hong Kong Delivery, Cathay 251, Stand Whiskey 42, Information Delta, request clearance to Tokyo Haneda.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Initial contact with Delivery requesting IFR clearance to Tokyo Haneda, confirming receipt of current ATIS Information Delta.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Departure, Cathay 251, altimeter setting one zero one two verified, level is two thousand five hundred feet. Cycling transponder.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The crew confirms the altimeter setting and actual level, and cycles the transponder to reset the Mode C encoder.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Departure, Cathay 251, passing one thousand five hundred feet, climbing via SID to Flight Level zero nine zero.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The mandatory initial check-in on Departure: station, callsign, passing altitude, climbing-to level, and SID.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Departure, Cathay 251, UNABLE to expedite, maximum climb rate 800 feet per minute.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot declares unable to expedite, stating a maximum climb rate of 800 fpm at heavy weight.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Ground, Cathay 251, low visibility, request progressive taxi to Runway 07 Right.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: In dense fog (RVR 400m), the crew requests step-by-step progressive taxi guidance to Runway 07R.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Ground, Cathay 251, pushback complete, request taxi.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot reports the pushback is finished and requests taxi clearance.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Ground, Cathay 251, Stand Whiskey 42, request push and start, Information Charlie.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Initial call requesting permission to push back from the gate and start engines, confirming receipt of ATIS information Charlie.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Ground, Cathay 251, Stand Whiskey 42, request push and start, Information Echo.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Initial call to Ground requesting pushback and engine start from Stand Whiskey 42 with Information Echo.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Ground, Cathay 251, Stand Whiskey 42, request taxi to remote de-icing pad North.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot requests taxi from the stand to the remote de-icing pad for surface treatment.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Ground, Cathay 251, Stand Whiskey 42, request taxi.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot requests taxi clearance from the stand.

phrases.text: Hong Kong International Airport Information Delta. Time zero zero three zero. Runway zero seven Right in use for arrival, Runway zero seven Left in use for departure. Wind zero eight zero degrees, one five knots. Visibility one zero kilometers. Few clouds two thousand feet. Temperature two seven, dewpoint two four. QNH one zero one four hectopascals. Acknowledge information Delta on initial contact.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The full automated ATIS broadcast (Information Delta) giving the 0030Z observation: runways 07R arrival / 07L departure, wind 080° at 15 knots, 10 km visibility, few clouds at 2,000 feet, temperature 27°C, dewpoint 24°C, QNH 1014 hPa.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay 251, approaching Runway 07 Left on Hotel, ready to cross.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot informs Tower they are approaching Runway 07L on taxiway Hotel and are ready to cross.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay 251, holding point Runway 07 Right on Alpha, ready for departure.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot reports holding short at the runway holding point and ready to depart.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay 251, holdover time has expired, unable departure, request taxi to de-icing pad for re-treatment.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot reports that holdover time has expired in the departure queue, declares unable to depart, and requests taxi back to the de-icing pad for re-treatment.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay 251, negative contact on the Airbus 320, holding short Runway 07 Right.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The crew cannot see the Airbus 320, so they report negative contact and remain holding short rather than entering the runway on assumption.

phrases.text: Information Echo acknowledged, wind zero six zero at two two gusts three five, windshear Runway zero seven Left, QNH one zero one one, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Acknowledging the Special ATIS update and reading back the new wind, windshear report, and QNH.

phrases.text: Monitor
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: 'Listen out on frequency' — tune the frequency and listen without transmitting an initial check call.

phrases.text: Negative
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: 'No' / 'Permission not granted' / 'That is not correct' — used by ATC to deny requests or flag pilot readback errors.

phrases.text: Negative contact, holding short.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The report a pilot must make when the referenced traffic is not visible — never enter the runway without visual contact.

phrases.text: One two one decimal six, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the frequency change to 121.6.

phrases.text: One two three decimal eight, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot reads back the new frequency, confirming the transfer.

phrases.text: Push and start approved, facing south, QNH 1012, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: A faulty readback — the pilot said 'facing south' instead of 'facing north', which ATC must correct.

phrases.text: Push and Start Approved, Facing West
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Clearance to disconnect ground power, connect the motorized tug, push backwards out of the gate alleyway, and start the engines so the nose points west when finished.

phrases.text: Push and start approved, facing west, QNH 1012, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Mandatory readback of the pushback clearance, facing direction, and altimeter setting.

phrases.text: Push and start approved, facing west, QNH 1012.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC approves pushback and engine start with the nose finishing pointing west, confirming the local altimeter setting QNH 1012.

phrases.text: Push and start approved, facing west, QNH 1013, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Full readback of the pushback clearance and corrected altimeter setting.

phrases.text: Push and start approved, facing west, QNH 1014, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Mandatory readback confirming the pushback clearance, final facing direction, and altimeter setting.

phrases.text: QNH 1013, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the corrected altimeter setting QNH 1013.

phrases.text: QNH 1014, correction, QNH 1013
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The local barometric altimeter setting (1 hPa ≈ 27–30 feet); an uncorrected 10 hPa error would create a 300-foot altitude discrepancy and a level-bust risk.

phrases.text: QNH one zero two four, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: A faulty readback — the pilot said 1024 instead of 1014, a +10 hPa error the controller must catch.

phrases.text: Request progressive taxi instructions
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot asks ATC for step-by-step turn-by-turn guidance, used in low visibility or at unfamiliar airports.

phrases.text: Right on Hotel, Ground on one two one decimal six, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot reads back the return taxi routing and frequency.

phrases.text: Roger
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: 'I have received all of your last transmission' — acknowledges receipt only; NEVER use for instructions requiring compliance or readbacks.

phrases.text: Runway 07 Right, cleared for takeoff, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Standard readback of the takeoff clearance.

phrases.text: Runway 07 Right, line up and wait, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Standard readback of the line-up authorization.

phrases.text: Say again
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: 'Repeat all, or the specified part, of this message' — the mandatory request for repetition; the word 'REPEAT' is strictly forbidden in civil aviation.

phrases.text: Slot time 0345. Cancel OCEAN 2A, new departure BEKOL 3A, climb via SID Flight Level 080, squawk 7142, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the amended clearance (slot time, cancelled and replacement departures, new level and squawk) with the callsign last.

phrases.text: Squawk ident.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: The command to press the transponder IDENT button so the radar tag blooms and flashes for identification.

phrases.text: Standby
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: 'Wait and I will call you' — the controller is busy or coordinating; do not reply, wait for ATC to call back.

phrases.text: Standby, traffic passing behind.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Instruction to remain static at the gate because another aircraft is taxiing across the pushback path.

phrases.text: Starting engine number two.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Announcement to the ground crew that engine number two is being ignited.

phrases.text: Station calling Ground, stepped on, unreadable. Cathay 251, say again your stand number.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Two pilots transmitted at the same instant and blocked each other, so the controller asks Cathay 251 to repeat its stand number.

phrases.text: Stopping climb at Flight Level one two zero, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's readback confirming the climb is being arrested at FL120.

phrases.text: Stopping, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's readback confirming the emergency stop.

phrases.text: Stopping, holding short Runway 07 Left, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot confirms immediate max braking and compliance with the cancelled clearance, holding short of Runway 07L.

phrases.text: Taxi to de-icing pad North via Alpha, hold short pad entrance, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot reads back the taxi clearance to the de-icing pad.

phrases.text: Taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via Alpha and Hotel, crossing Runway 07 Left, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: A dangerous faulty readback — the pilot said 'crossing Runway 07 Left' instead of 'hold short', which the controller must catch immediately.

phrases.text: Taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via Alpha and Hotel, give way to the Boeing 777 on Bravo, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the taxi route and the give-way instruction.

phrases.text: Taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via Alpha, crossing Runway 07 Left, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's readback incorrectly says 'crossing Runway 07 Left' instead of 'hold short' -- a dangerous misreadback creating a runway incursion hazard.

phrases.text: Taxi to holding point Runway 07 Right via Alpha, hold short Runway 07 Left, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Readback of the taxi route and the mandatory hold-short instruction.

phrases.text: Taxi to holding point Runway zero seven Right via Alpha and Hotel, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot reads back the taxi clearance to the holding point.

phrases.text: Turn left heading zero six zero, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's readback of the traffic-avoidance turn.

phrases.text: Type four fluid, holdover time zero zero four five, post inspection complete, request taxi Runway zero seven Right, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The taught readback confirming Type IV fluid and the holdover start time, requesting taxi to the runway.

phrases.text: Type four fluid, holdover time zero zero four five, post inspection complete, request taxi to Runway zero seven Right, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The pilot's mandatory readback confirming the fluid type and holdover start time, and requesting taxi to the runway.

phrases.text: Wilco
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: 'I understand your message and will comply with it' — abbreviation of 'Will Comply', used to acknowledge instructions requiring future execution.

phrases.text: Wilco, Cathay 251.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: The correct response to 'Cathay 251, report passing waypoint PORPA' — an instruction requiring future compliance.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, passing eight thousand feet climbing to Flight Level one six zero.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Initial climb check-in: station, callsign, passing altitude and cleared level.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, climb to Flight Level one six zero, transition altitude nine thousand, standard altimeter setting one zero one three.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC clears the climb to FL160 and issues the transition altitude with the standard pressure setting.

phrases.text: Climb to Flight Level one six zero, standard set one zero one three, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the cleared level and the standard altimeter setting.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, stop climb at Flight Level one four zero, expedite climb through Flight Level one wun zero, traffic twelve o'clock opposite direction Boeing seven seven seven level at Flight Level one fife zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: Urgent instruction: stop the climb at FL140 but expedite through FL110 due to opposite-direction traffic at FL150.

phrases.text: Stopping climb at Flight Level one four zero, expediting climb through Flight Level one wun zero, traffic in sight, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot confirms stopping the climb at FL140, expediting through FL110, with the traffic in sight.

phrases.text: Stopping climb at Flight Level one four zero, standard altimeter one zero one three, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Correct readback form: the standard keyword is 'stopping climb' (never 'level off'), and the pressure value must be read back numerically.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, passing Flight Level one wun zero climbing to Flight Level one six zero.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Check-in while climbing: passing FL110, cleared to FL160.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Radar, radar contact, turn left heading zero seven zero, vector for sequencing.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC establishes radar contact and issues a radar vector: turn left to heading 070 for sequencing.

phrases.text: Turn left heading zero seven zero, vector for sequencing, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the heading instruction and the vector's purpose.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, turn left heading zero two zero, descend to five thousand feet.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC vectors the aircraft onto heading 020 with a descent to 5,000 ft.

phrases.text: Hong Kong Radar, Cathay two five one, unable descent to five thousand feet on heading zero two zero due high terrain, minimum vectoring altitude is seven thousand feet.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot exercises the terrain veto: unable the descent due to high terrain, stating the minimum vectoring altitude of 7,000 ft.

phrases.text: Cathay two five one, roger, maintain seven thousand feet, maintain heading zero seven zero.
phrases.speaker: ATC
phrases.meaning: ATC accepts the veto and amends the clearance: maintain 7,000 ft and heading 070.

phrases.text: Maintain seven thousand feet, maintain heading zero seven zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Pilot reads back the amended altitude and heading.

phrases.text: Fly heading zero niner zero, descending to Flight Level one zero zero, Cathay two five one.
phrases.speaker: Pilot
phrases.meaning: Correct readback form: say 'heading' (never 'track') and always include 'Flight Level'.
